response.text:
**Target:** AAPL FY2023 year-over-year revenue growth.

**Calculation:** (FY2023 revenue − FY2022 revenue) ÷ FY2022 revenue = (383,285,000,000 − 394,328,000,000) ÷ 394,328,000,000 = −11,043,000,000 ÷ 394,328,000,000 = −0.02800 → −2.80%.

**Evidence:** Apple Inc. 10-K filings — FY2023 revenue $383,285M (us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, period 2022-09-25 to 2023-09-30, accn 0000320193-23-000106, filed 2023-11-03) and FY2022 revenue $394,328M (period 2021-09-26 to 2022-09-24, accn 0000320193-22-000108, filed 2022-10-28). Both values were confirmed via the SEC XBRL company-facts tool. Note FY2023 was a 53-week fiscal year, which slightly boosted reported growth relative to a 52-week basis.

ANSWER: -2.80%
